mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in unemployment rate below 6.0% triggers stronger labor market confidence, driving corporate earnings growth and positive S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns do not rise above baseline when UNRATE crosses below 6.0% in a sustained manner.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent growth in GDP (GDPC1) and housing starts (HOUST) signals robust demand, leading to sustained S&P 500 appreciation over 60 trading days as investors anticipate continued economic expansion.
failure_condition: Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-month rolling window, or 60-day returns fail to correlate with both GDPC1 and HOUST trends.

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production (INDPRO) during a post-recession recovery phase reduces supply bottlenecks, enhancing corporate profits and S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns do not rise when INDPRO shows sustained growth during the specified regime period.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the CPI inflation index above 3.0% prompts market concerns about future rate hikes, leading to negative S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns do not turn negative within the 5-day window following the CPIAUCSL crossing above 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Elevated jobless claims (PAYEMS) signal weakening labor demand, prompting market pessimism and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns do not decline when PAYEMS shows sustained increases above historical averages.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, simultaneous growth in GDP (GDPC1) and retail sales (RSAFS) drive investor optimism, sustaining S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-month rolling window, or 60-day returns fail to correlate with both GDPC1 and RSAFS trends.

mechanism_narrative: A convergence of falling unemployment (UNRATE) and rising jobless claims (PAYEMS) signals labor market strengthening, boosting corporate profits and positive S&P 500 returns within 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns do not rise when both UNRATE and PAYEMS show converging trends in a sustained manner.
